arrive.text: A clear night. More stars than anyone could count.

listen.text: Only static. The hiss of the stars.

stars.text: Billions of stars, and around most of them, planets.

old.text: Some are far older than the Sun. Someone should have come by now.

send_1.text: Your message leaves at the speed of light.

send_2.text: Years pass. Nothing comes back. Maybe no one is there. Or maybe they're listening too, and staying quiet.

listen_end.text: Nights become years. Only static. Either they're rare, or they're quiet, or we're early.

logbook.text: The log goes back years. Every night, the same entry. Nothing.

tea.text: Your tea has gone cold. It always does, out here.

moon.text: Only one other world has ever had visitors. They left footprints, and went home.
